hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && git diff HEAD -U0 -- src | grep -E '^\+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -E '//|/\*|\*/|<!--' | sed 's/^+[[:space:]]*//' | jq -R -s 'select(length > 0) | {systemMessage: ("Comment lines added to src/ — check each against the Cleanup Pass rule in AGENTS.md. Only genuinely surprising things: a workaround, an external constraint, an invariant not visible from the code. Not restating the next line, not justifying an ordinary decision.\n\n" + .)}' 2>/dev/null || true
